o: Phone companion declares INTERNET and ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE permissions, Trumore package query, launcher activity, action activity, and action receiver.
Phone application configures dynamic and static launcher shortcuts for Lock, Unlock, Climate, Defrost, Trunk, and Refresh actions.
TelemetryParser parses vehicle JSON payload into high voltage battery SoC, remaining range, charge rate kW, 12V battery, tire PSI, locks, climate, and GPS coordinates.
VehicleTelemetry checks 12V battery threshold (critical below 60%) and evaluates individual tire pressure warning states.
SecureTokenStorage and ToggAuthManager securely encrypt and persist user auth tokens, refresh tokens, and session expiration timestamps.
TvaApiClient performs HTTPS network requests to Togg TVA cloud endpoints for telemetry retrieval, lock/unlock, climate start/stop, and locate horn/lights.
TrumoreBridge verifies com.togg.toggmobile package presence, launching direct intent integrations or Play Store fallback.
TelemetryDatabaseHelper caches vehicle telemetry records into local SQLite database for instant offline dashboard restoration.
WearSyncManager and PhoneWearListenerService exchange telemetry data between phone and watch over Wearable Data Layer path /togg_telemetry.
Wear OS watch application declares android.hardware.type.watch, fine/coarse location, vibration, wake lock, standalone metadata, and tile service provider.
MainActivity renders AMOLED dark UI with high voltage battery arc, remaining range, 12V status, 4-wheel tire pressures, vehicle lock switch, and climate toggle.
ToggActionActivity and ToggActionReceiver execute headless vehicle commands for Samsung Modes & Routines and togg://action URI intents.
ToggLoginActivity presents credential input and handles session login with ToggAuthManager.
Wear MainActivity renders circular AMOLED watch UI with battery SoC, range, 12V indicator, and live compass bearing toward vehicle GPS coordinates.
Wear MainActivity launches Google Maps walking navigation directly to vehicle park coordinates.
ToggTileService provides Wear OS Tile for quick-glance battery, range, and 12V status without opening the main watch app.
TelemetryParserTest executes JUnit tests asserting proper parsing of vehicle battery, range, tires, locks, and location data.
validate-kb.cjs asserts JSONL integrity, entity and file ID uniqueness, source file existence, and index route consistency.
DigitalKey and DigitalKeyManager parse Trumore digital key invitations, deep links, URLs, and SE- reference codes, storing authorized credentials in SharedPreferences.
WearSyncManager broadcasts digital keys to connected Galaxy Watch nodes over /togg_digital_key and handles /execute_key_action execution on phone.
Wear MainActivity renders active digital key card with remaining validity badge and quick lock/unlock actions.
DigitalKeyTest executes unit tests verifying Trumore URI parsing, reference code extraction, expiration checks, and JSON round-trip serialization.
MainActivity home tab omits the vehicle hero photo card and centers the two quick action buttons (door lock and trunk).
MainActivity renders specialized 4-wheel tire pressure card structured around a central '+' cross axis with front tires positioned above and rear tires below.
MainActivity renders customizable circular quick action buttons at the top of the home page with persistent user reordering.
TelemetryDatabaseHelper and SecureTokenStorage persist vehicle GPS coordinates, park address, trunk state, headlights, and drive mode to eliminate cold-boot demo fallback.
MainActivity renders embedded Google Maps interactive view and parking address directly inside the vehicle location home card.
MainActivity lets users select Eco, Comfort (Konfor), or Sport (Spor) from the drive mode card or driving value, updates telemetry, stores it in SQLite, and synchronizes it to the watch.

ToggActionActivity and ToggActionReceiver support drive_mode_eco, drive_mode_comfort, drive_mode_sport, and drive_mode_next by updating persisted telemetry; activity and receiver sync the updated telemetry to the watch.
MainActivity toggles ready-to-drive from the quick actions bar, digital key action, and Digital Key home card, checking canStartDrive when a key is registered.
VehicleTelemetry exposes isReadyToDrive and withReadyToDrive while retaining backwards-compatible constructors and copy helpers.
TelemetryDatabaseHelper persists ready-to-drive in is_ready_to_drive and migrates existing telemetry rows.
WearSyncManager includes ready-to-drive state in synchronized telemetry for connected watches.
ToggActionActivity and ToggActionReceiver handle emotor, emotor_start, emotor_stop, and ACTION_EMOTOR_TOGGLE commands with digital key drive authorization.
READY toggling is available from the standalone Home e-Motor card and does not require a registered digital key.
Home quick actions exclude e-Motor, support user selection from the vehicle action catalog, and persist order in SecureTokenStorage.
Digital Key pairing and watch transfer controls are in Settings; the Digital Key card is suppressed from the Home grid.
SecureTokenStorage persists system, dark, or light app theme preference; MainActivity applies it on launch and after selection.
Home header shows model and update time without VIN; Settings shows VIN, and Home cards use Liquid Glass surfaces.

TvaApiClient uses FriendVehicleInfo only when an Owner ID is configured, appends it as ownerId, and otherwise reports descriptive primary vehicle 401/404 guidance; Settings persists the optional Owner ID.

MainActivity removes legacy SAM and refresh bottom buttons, formats header sync time from system published telemetry timestamp, and provides a resizable Liquid Glass home screen widget for Galaxy S25 Ultra displaying vehicle location, battery SoC, estimated range, and expandable tire pressures with 12V battery status.
ToggAppWidgetProvider renders the latest cached telemetry snapshot, or creates a demo snapshot from saved VIN and plate settings when the cache is empty.
The Android widget receiver is exported for launcher delivery; its provider metadata requests a 30-minute update period and uses the widget layout as its preview.
The widget expanded section uses FrameLayout as its divider so its layout is supported by RemoteViews.

TelemetryParser prioritizes vehicle hardware timestamps (including producedOn and sensor timestamps) over generic updatedOn, supports ISO and epoch formats, returns zero when no timestamp exists, and excludes the gateway response timestamp; the API client and dashboard persist only positive vehicle timestamps. MainActivity displays driving trip distances rounded to whole kilometers.

Home driving card prefers myTrip over currentTrip, falls back to odometer-based trip data, and displays rounded distance, formatted duration, average consumption, and average speed without emoji or badge headers; dashboard odometer remains an ungrouped integer, while the header shows vehicle synchronization and app refresh times separately, with app refresh persisted in SecureTokenStorage.

TelemetryParser treats odometerStatus readings and direct odometer values at or above 50000 as meters and converts them to kilometers; smaller direct odometer values remain kilometers. Vehicle timestamp selection checks data.timestamp then data.producedOn before telemetry sensor producedOn and updatedOn fallbacks.
Corrective fact for AF047: MainActivity source text is UTF-8 without BOM and the Home card label is YolculuÃ„Å¸um; this replaces the mojibake spelling recorded in AF047.
Corrective fact for AF048: vehicle sync selection reads data.timestamp, root.timestamp, data.dateFormat, then producedOn and other vehicle event keys; updatedOn is never used as vehicle sync time.
TelemetryParser accepts Turkish month names and dotted Turkish date formats in Europe/Istanbul time for vehicle sync timestamps.
Corrective fact for AF042: dashboard header shows full Turkish vehicle sync date and time independently from app HTTP refresh time, omitting refresh when unknown.
Dashboard lock, trunk, and e-Motor actions require BLE connection and persist or render updated state only after successful command feedback.
Corrective fact for AF034: headless lock, trunk, and e-Motor actions route through VehicleBleManager, preserve digital key start authorization, and only persist successful feedback.
VehicleTelemetry copy helpers retain the original vehicle sync timestamp when local command feedback changes state.
MainActivity formats positive vehicle sync timestamps with Turkish locale pattern d MMMM yyyy - HH:mm.

Trumore 2.1.25 SmartAccess BLE uses service f0002412-0451-4000-b000-000000000000, command write characteristic f0002413-0451-4000-b000-000000000000, feedback notify characteristic f0002415-0451-4000-b000-000000000000, and CCCD 00002902-0000-1000-8000-00805f9b34fb.

Corrective fact for AF053: VehicleBleManager also scans for the SmartAccess service UUID or names containing togg, t10, or sda; GATT connection discovers services and enables feedback notifications before exposing CONNECTED.

Corrective fact for AF054: real GATT commands write A1 01 lock, A1 00 unlock, A2 01 trunk, A3 01 e-Motor start, or A3 00 e-Motor stop to the command characteristic; feedback notification resolves the pending callback, with a 2.5-second write-success timeout fallback that updates telemetry.

Home header lets users edit and persist the vehicle title in SecureTokenStorage, shows an enlarged centered plate badge, and stacks vehicle synchronization and app refresh timestamps on separate lines beside it.
Tire sub-card drawables use theme-aware card_inner/card_stroke and tire_low_bg/tire_low_stroke color resources, with light and night values, for legible theme-adaptive pressure boxes.

Widget map preview removes the live telemetry, map-link, and coordinate labels and their backgrounds; the top-right badge displays the full vehicle sync timestamp matching the app header, formatted as d MMMM yyyy - HH:mm in Turkish locale.

MainActivity propagates cached, rendered, refreshed, fallback, settings, lifecycle telemetry or vehicle-name changes to all home-screen widgets, and captures its embedded map WebView to the app-local widget_map_snapshot.png before refreshing widgets.

The widget selects active telemetry serialized as JSON in SharedPreferences before falling back to latest SQLite row and then a demo snapshot; its 12V bitmap uses the selected live telemetry value. MainActivity saves active telemetry when rendering dashboard state, after successful vehicle commands, and on successful API refresh; successful park-address geocoding also saves the address and location to preferences and telemetry to active storage and SQLite, then refreshes widgets. SQLite getLatest orders by insertion ID descending and inserts replace nonpositive timestamps with current time. Widget minResizeWidth is 180dp, preventing 1-column resizing; width thresholds 240dp and 310dp select 2-column charge+map, 3-column (+tires+address), and 4-column (+12V) layouts.

Home quick action row displays centered door lock and trunk buttons without its quick actions title; card customization is in Settings, and home customization offers battery, drive, tires, location, and 12V cards while suppressing controls and climate cards including from older preferences.

The widget map HUD removes live telemetry, map-link, and coordinate labels and displays the full vehicle sync timestamp matching the app header in its top-right badge; the range HUD continues to display its perspective road graphic, charging badge, and centered range text.

Expanded map preview overlays live GPS status, telemetry timestamp, a cyan beacon pin, and Google Maps label on a dark zoom-16 Carto tile cached in app cache; while a tile is unavailable it shows a coordinate radar and street fallback and fetches the tile asynchronously. Map tap opens turn-by-turn navigation when resolvable and geo view otherwise.

Corrective fact for AF069: the widget map has no Carto tile fetch or asynchronous tile cache; it displays the MainActivity local WebView snapshot when available, otherwise a local road-free radar grid, and map image taps launch Google Maps navigation with geo fallback.

Exported vehicle action activity and receiver require the app signature permission com.togg.companion.permission.CONTROL_VEHICLE; the browsable togg://action path is removed and vehicle commands from that URI are rejected.

SecureTokenStorage and DigitalKeyManager use AES-256 encrypted SharedPreferences backed by Android Keystore, migrate existing plaintext values into encrypted preferences and clear legacy stores only after commit, and fall back to private preferences if encryption is unavailable.
The app disables cleartext network traffic and trusts system certificates for togg.cloud, toggid.togg.cloud, tva-api.togg.cloud, and trumore.app; the Togg login WebView rejects third-party cookies.

Before BLE LOCK, UNLOCK, TRUNK, or EMOTOR commands, VehicleBleManager rejects expired or invalid saved digital keys and enforces canLock, canUnlock, canTrunk, and canStartDrive for the matching command.
Wear OS disables backup, stores the watch digital key in EncryptedSharedPreferences with migration from plaintext preferences, and listens for /togg_digital_key data changes.
PhoneWearListenerService accepts key actions only from connected sender nodes with exact allowed action strings and executes authorized BLE actions directly when MainActivity is absent.
When no digital key is saved, VehicleBleManager requires demo mode or a valid owner session token for BLE vehicle commands.
TelemetryDatabaseHelper keeps at most the newest 100 telemetry history rows after inserts and exposes clearHistory to wipe history.
Release builds enable R8 minification and resource shrinking with rules preserving telemetry and key models, widget and action components, and security crypto classes.
The phone dashboard presents trip distance, odometer, and separate vehicle update timestamps.

VehicleBleManager detects active Bluetooth connection via device reflection, supports broad vehicle name heuristics, scans for surrounding BLE devices, and maintains connection without disconnecting on custom GATT UUID absence.
AbrpJobService requests fresh telemetry through TvaApiClient and sends it through AbrpClient on a chained 7-minute one-shot JobScheduler schedule with a network constraint when configured.
AbrpClient sets consumption from lastTripAvgConsumption when positive, otherwise from positive currentTrip.avgConsumption.
AbrpJobService is non-exported and protected by BIND_JOB_SERVICE.
The ABRP open button launches com.iternio.abrpapp first, then com.iternio.abrp, then the ABRP website.
ABRP enablement, user token, selected capacity, and last successful transmission time are stored through SecureTokenStorage encrypted preferences.
AbrpClientTest checks required JSON telemetry fields, calculated state of energy, charging state, and optional coordinates.

The home dashboard always appends a full-width ABRP card after the configured home cards and location card; the card displays 7-minute sync status and vehicle telemetry and offers send, open, and settings actions.

The settings dialog content is vertically scrollable and includes an ABRP settings shortcut near the top; the shortcut opens a dedicated dialog for ABRP enablement, token, battery capacity, manual send, and app launch.
